meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成支持备注和跳转的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常要把资料整理成可演示的幻灯片
copy.tagline_en: Turn your content into a presentation deck with speaker notes and branching.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn rough notes into a navigable slide deck for presenting.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能把内容做成可翻页的 HyperFrames 幻灯片：含独立分页、分段显现、热点跳转分支和演讲者备注，并带演示模式。产出是可运行 deck（用 hyperframes present 打开），不是视频文件；也能把已有网页转成同款 deck。
howto.when: 明确说“slideshow”“slide show”或“HyperFrames slideshow”时直接开始；说“presentation”“pitch deck”等相近请求或要求转换网页时，会先询问是否要做成 HyperFrames 幻灯片，得到同意后才制作。

say.text: 把我刚写的大纲做成一页一页的 HyperFrames 幻灯片。
say.note: Claude 会开始创建 deck，并配好导航和备注。

say.text: 把这个产品介绍网页转换成可点击浏览的 deck。
say.note: 会尽量保留原页面的设计、动效与交互。

say.text: 第 3 页加一个热点跳转分支，并给那页写备注。
say.note: 会新增分支幻灯片和可点击的跳转热点。

howto.what_en: Claude authors a runnable HyperFrames slideshow — discrete slides, fragment reveals, branch hotspots, presenter notes, presenter mode. Output: navigable deck via `hyperframes present`, not an MP4; also converts a page into a deck.
howto.when_en: Triggers on explicit asks for a slideshow, slide show, or HyperFrames slideshow (or confirmation via /hyperframes). For adjacent asks like “presentation” or page conversion, Claude asks first and only authors after yes.

say_en.text: Turn my outline into a page-by-page HyperFrames slideshow.
say_en.note: Claude starts authoring the deck with navigation and notes.

say_en.text: Convert this product intro page into a click-through deck.
say_en.note: Claude keeps the page’s design, motion, and interactions.

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on slide 3 that jumps into a branch, and write notes for that slide.
say_en.note: Claude adds a branch slide and a click target.
